# Count the number of films where the 'Film' column is not empty and the 'Year' is not a future year (assuming 2014 is the latest year in the table)
# Since the question asks for films they have already appeared in, we exclude rows where 'Notes' indicates "Announced" or "Filming"
# We'll filter out rows where 'Notes' contains "Announced" or "Filming" (case-insensitive)
# Also ensure the film name is not empty
appeared_films = df[
    df['Film'].notna() & 
    df['Film'].astype(str).str.strip().ne('') &
    ~df['Notes'].astype(str).str.contains('Announced|Filming', case=False, na=False)
]
# Count the number of unique films (distinct film titles)
answer = appeared_films['Film'].nunique()
